organizations.publicNote: German recording company active from 1925 to 1972; the linked discs use Electrola as their imprint. In 1972 Electrola-Gesellschaft and Carl Lindström GmbH were merged into the successor company EMI Electrola. The designation E.G. belongs to a record series, not to the organization’s name.

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester. “Du lieber Geiger, spiel’ einen Tango für mich.” Tango; label credits Dr. Kaper and German, with words by Fritz Rotter. Electrola E.G. 2271, label number 60-1520; issued June 1931. Disc label shown in the YouTube transfer published by 78rpm Musik.

sources.researchNote: The displayed label reads “Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang”, identifies Marek Weber und sein Orchester and gives E.G. 2271 and 60-1520. The earlier statement that no label was shown was incorrect. Henry König’s Electrola label list supplies matrix OD267-1, a session at the Berlin Electrola studio on 24 March 1931 and release in June 1931, citing Discographie der deutschen Tanzmusik, p. 2526. The list describes the side as “Instr.”, in conflict with the wording on the label itself, not merely with the uploader’s description. The discrepancy remains unresolved; no refrain singer is identified here. The structured date describes the catalogue issue, not a session or the manufacture of the photographed copy; the catalogued take is not confirmed from the visible runout.
